newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Oil firm Noyabrskneftegaz approves share issue.
newsitem.headline: Oil firm Noyabrskneftegaz approves share issue.

text.p: The board of Russia's Noyarbrskneftegaz, the main oil production unit of oil holding company Sibneft, has approved a share issue to pay off its debts to the federal budget, a Sibneft spokesman said on Wednesday.
"The decision to issue shares has been taken; however, all details will be officially announced after members of the board return to Moscow," he said.

The government has a debt restructuring programme for companies to issue shares which are then tranferred to the government. The government can sell the shares if the company falls behind on its tax payments.
Noyabrskneftegaz's tax debts were 1.95 trillion roubles ($339 million) as of June.
The company's shareholders in May approved a proposal to increase authorised but unissued capital by 30.83 trillion roubles, from its current 15.71 billion roubles.
Sibneft is one of a dozen or so of Russia's vertically-integrated oil companies.
